theorem check_repository_action_spec (db : tables.Db) (ip : Option net.IpAddr) (user repo : U64)
    (a : Slice U8) (hf : tables.Query.RepositoryAction ∉ db.failing.val) :
    ∃ b, permission.check_repository_action db ip user repo a false = ok (.Ok b) ∧
      (b = true ↔ RepoAction db ip user repo (nats a.val)) := by
  sorry

spec.name: nats
spec.code:
/-- A byte string as numbers. -/
def nats (v : List U8) : List Nat := v.map (·.val)

spec.name: RepoAction
spec.code:
/-- `check_repository_action` for a non-admin: an `admin` role always wins;
otherwise the applicable rules decide when there are any, and the roles
decide when there are none. -/
def RepoAction (db : tables.Db) (ip : Option net.IpAddr) (user repo : U64) (a : List Nat) : Prop :=
  RoleGrants db user repo (lit "admin") ∨
  ((∃ p, Applicable db ip user repo p) ∧
    ∃ p, Applicable db ip user repo p ∧ (Carries p.actions.val a ∨ Carries p.actions.val (lit "admin"))) ∨
  ((¬ ∃ p, Applicable db ip user repo p) ∧ (RoleGrants db user repo a ∨ RoleGrants db user repo (lit "admin")))

spec.name: Applicable
lit
spec.code:
/-- The UTF-8 bytes of a literal. -/
def lit (s : String) : List Nat := s.toUTF8.toList.map (·.toNat)

spec.name: Carries
spec.code:
/-- Some entry of `xs` spells `a`. -/
def Carries (xs : List (alloc.vec.Vec U8)) (a : List Nat) : Prop := ∃ x ∈ xs, nats x.val = a

spec.name: RoleGrants
spec.code:
/-- A role assigned to the user on this repository, or on all of them,
carries `perm`. -/
def RoleGrants (db : tables.Db) (user repo : U64) (perm : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ ra ∈ db.role_assignments.val, ra.user_id = user ∧
    (ra.repository_id = some repo ∨ ra.repository_id = none) ∧
    ∃ r ∈ db.roles.val, r.id = ra.role_id ∧ Carries r.permissions.val perm

lean.name: permission.check_repository_action
lean.code:
/-- [artifactkeeper_kernel::permission::check_repository_action]:
    Source: 'src/permission.rs', lines 135:0-150:1
    Visibility: public -/
def permission.check_repository_action
  (db : tables.Db) (client_ip : Option net.IpAddr) (user_id : Std.U64)
  (repository_id : Std.U64) (action : Slice Std.U8) (is_admin : Bool) :
  Result (core.result.Result Bool AppError)
  := do
  if is_admin
  then ok (core.result.Result.Ok true)
  else
    let b ← tables.Db.fails db tables.Query.RepositoryAction
    if b
    then ok (core.result.Result.Err AppError.Database)
    else
      let s ←
        lift (Array.to_slice
          (Array.make 5#usize [ 97#u8, 100#u8, 109#u8, 105#u8, 110#u8 ]))
      let owner ← permission.assigned_role_has db user_id repository_id s
      let b1 ← permission.any_applicable db client_ip user_id repository_id
      let decided ←
        if b1
        then
          permission.any_applicable_grants db client_ip user_id repository_id
            action
        else
          do
          let b2 ←
            permission.assigned_role_has db user_id repository_id action
          if b2
          then ok true
          else
            let s1 ←
              lift (Array.to_slice
                (Array.make 5#usize [ 97#u8, 100#u8, 109#u8, 105#u8, 110#u8 ]))
            permission.assigned_role_has db user_id repository_id s1
      if owner
      then ok (core.result.Result.Ok true)
      else ok (core.result.Result.Ok decided)
